name: Omavoice
author: Slava Baranskyi
description: Talk to a local agent out loud. Hold F10: whisper hears you and Kokoro answers, both on this machine; codex or claude finds the answer here and on the web. No API key, and nothing spoken leaves the machine.

barWidget.description: Voice assistant with access to this machine

schema.label: Local agent
schema.description: Who finds the answer: codex runs on a ChatGPT subscription, claude knows your skills and MCP servers.

schema.label: Show state as text
schema.description: One word next to the icon: listening, looking, speaking. Lets you talk to the assistant without opening the panel.
